mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies with a temperature of 39 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, while a Waxing Crescent moon glows above us tonight. Also, keep your eyes on the sky because the space station will be visible tonight starting at 6:31 PM; it will rise in the west-southwest over Mount Horeb and travel toward the east-northeast heading over the Fitchburg and Madison area, passing almost directly overhead for three minutes.

The Verona Plan Commission is meeting this Monday to discuss several development projects, including site plans and traffic studies for the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, if you have a traffic citation, the Municipal Court reminds you that you can handle many matters online or by mail unless a mandatory court appearance is noted on your ticket.

We have a busy schedule ahead, with Yoga at Insight Wellness today and ART House 360 events tonight. Looking further ahead, Hop Haus trivia kicks off tomorrow in Verona, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee this weekend.

In a report from October 25, local officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where they located a man behind the wheel who was subsequently arrested for an O W I charge.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open, so stop in to grab a scoop before they close their doors at 11:00 PM tonight.
